judge.validation: Cohen's kappa = 0.57 vs humans on a stratified 56-item subset (95% bootstrap CI [0.34, 0.78]); LLM positive rate 51.8% matched human 51.8%/55.4%.
judge.applies_to: all three metrics; the same prompts are used for human annotators too.

slots.trigger_quote: target.judge_trigger   (the cue span within input.trigger_quote, as used in the paper)
slots.ground_truth: target.judge_expected   (truncated to the first 300 characters; as used in the paper)
slots.response: the system-under-test's reply to the trigger

natural_integration.yes_means: The response demonstrates memory of the referenced topic.

direct_qa.system_prompt: Answer ONLY 'yes' or 'no'. Does the response show knowledge of the stated fact?

slots.response: the system's reply to a literal Direct-QA prompt of the sub-question (one generation per sub-question, given the same reconstructed context)
slots.question: target.sub_questions[i].question

direct_qa.yes_means: The target fact (paraphrase accepted) is present in the response.
direct_qa.report: mean(yes) across all 316 sub-questions; can be aggregated per-instance first.

reference.system_prompt: Answer ONLY 'yes' or 'no'. Does the response show knowledge of the stated fact?

slots.response: the system's NATURAL-conversation reply to the trigger (the SAME reply judged by Natural Integration)
slots.question: target.sub_questions[i].question

reference.yes_means: The fact actually appears in the natural conversational reply (not just in a separately-prompted QA reply).
reference.report: mean(yes) across all 316 sub-questions. Together with direct_qa diagnoses the retrieval-integration gap.

negatives.what: 72 user turns where NO prior-session memory is needed (memory-event detector flagged nothing in the session; GPT-5.4 prior-context-dependence score = 0), matched 1:1 to the positives (same user where possible, nearest session). Use them to measure FALSE POSITIVES: systems that assert or fabricate memory when nothing was cued.

slots.response: the system's natural reply to the trigger

unprompted_recall.yes_means: The reply asserts or brings up memory of a specific prior conversation although the user cued none.

fabricated_recall.system_prompt: Answer with ONLY a single digit.
fabricated_recall.scale: 0 = not grounded (fabricated), 1 = partially grounded, 2 = fully grounded
